physiology:
The traditions seat this code in the sacral plexus, the dense knot of nerves low in the pelvis, the place the body keeps its yes. It is the seat that fires before thought arrives. Hunger lives here. So does the willingness to begin a thing in the morning and still be doing it at dusk. It is fitting that the code of commitment sits in this nerve bed, the one organ whose whole language is whether the energy is on or it is off.

The shadow has a bodily floor in this plexus. Half-heartedness is not just an attitude, it is something the lower belly is doing. The yes leaves the room and the centre dims, and the body keeps moving on a thinner current pulled up from higher, the mind pushing the muscles around. Days run on this borrowed fuel. The held breath the card names sits exactly here. Lower belly tight. The flame in the basin kept low so that nothing can be too much asked of it.

The climb out is felt in the same place. Warmth gathers in the pelvis. The yes returns as a heat rather than a thought, and the body knows what it is for before the mind catches up. The Gene Keys call the felt sign of a true commitment a quiet warmth coursing through the whole being. The plexus is where that warmth begins. The code is not a vow you keep with the head. It is a fire kept lit in the floor of the body.
amino_acid:
Deeper than the plexus, this code answers to a single amino acid, Valine. Valine belongs to the small group the body cannot make for itself. It must be taken in, brought across the line of the mouth from outside, broken down, and only then put to use.

Valine's main work, once inside, is in the muscles, the slow steady fuelling of the tissue that keeps doing a thing long after the first burst of effort has gone. It is one of the body's quiet endurance chemistries. The molecule the cells reach for when the work is not done yet.

There is a teaching low under the card. The code of commitment runs on a chemistry that has to be received and a chemistry whose whole role is keeping the engine lit past the first surge. Commitment is not the leap. Commitment is what is still burning an hour later, and a year later, fed all along by something taken in from outside the self. The body says the same thing the card says, two layers down. You cannot make this on your own. You take it in, and then you stay.
